label: Signal Generator
description: Audio signal source. Choose a waveform or load an audio file.

properties.label: Waveform
properties.hint: The shape of the test signal this generator produces.

properties.label: Frequency (Hz)
properties.hint: The pitch of the test tone. A guitar's low E string is about 82Hz; middle A is 440Hz.

properties.label: Amplitude (V)
properties.hint: How loud/hard this signal hits the circuit — like picking softly versus digging in.

properties.label: Audio File
properties.hint: The recorded sample to play when Waveform is set to "Audio File".
